BiblicalUsage: Jeuz was a son of Shaharaim of Benjamin, named among the heads of the fathers. He stands with Shachia and Mirma, one of the sons who led their households.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the heads of the fathers, and Jeuz is remembered because his house was.
